title: Encoding Hierarchical Schema via Concept Flow for Multifaceted Ideology Detection
reasoning: The paper benchmarks multifaceted ideology detection, which includes explicit categories for 'Ethical Pursuit' (covering ethical liberalism and conservatism), 'Justice Orientation', and 'Church-State Relations' (covering secularism and religious influence in government). It evaluates model performance, including LLMs, on these specific moral, ethical, and religious dimensions of ideology.
